manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Reads scheduled field-service work orders for today and the next 7 days, computes per-technician daily utilization, and returns a saved (unsent) email draft plus a Teams-ready summary of overbooked, underbooked, and unas
manifest.display_name: Field Service Resource Utilization Daily Email
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/field_service_daily_utilization

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

date_range.description: Coverage window; defaults to today plus the next 7 days.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.

overbooked_threshold.description: Utilization percent above which a technician counts as overbooked; default 100%.

recipient.description: The service operations manager the email draft is addressed to.

teams_channel.description: Channel the Communications-ready summary is written for.

underbooked_threshold.description: Utilization percent below which a technician counts as slack; default 50%.
